Overview

 IDEMIA Public Security, a division of IDEMIA Group, is the leading provider of secure and trusted biometric-based solutions, transforming public and private organizations across the globe. Our industry-enabled and client-specific solutions draw upon decades of expertise in biometrics to revolutionize the fields of public security, justice and public safety, travel and transport, identity, and access control. Built on privacy and trust, our market-leading iris, fingerprint and facial recognition solutions top independent benchmarking for accuracy, fairness and scalability. These exacting standards enable our clients to build safer, fairer societies where people can live, interact, and move about freely. With 4000+ employees around the world and 150+ partners worldwide, we offer more than just a job - we provide a dynamic environment where innovation thrives, opportunities abound, and your talents are valued. Be part of a global leader shaping the future of biometric based technology. Learn more here .

 Responsibilities

 We are seeking a talented and enthusiastic Software Engineer Intern to join our team. As a Software Engineer Intern, you will work closely with our development team to design, develop, and maintain cloud-based software applications and data integration services. This internship will provide you with hands-on experience in full-stack and cloud software engineering and an opportunity to contribute to real-world projects that simplify digital transformation by streamlining data and task automation and improving data quality and governance.

 Key Responsibilities 

• Assist in the design, development, and testing of cloud-native applications and serverless services (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) that automate data and task workflows. 
 
• Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in TypeScript/Node.js, Python, and/or Java to enhance data and task automation. 
 
• Build and consume RESTful APIs and integrate systems and data sources to improve data quality and governance. 
 
• Contribute to front-end features using React, translating requirements into usable interfaces. 
 
• Collaborate with team members to gather requirements and provide technical solutions. 
 
• Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback. 
 
• Debug and resolve software defects and issues across the stack. 
 
• Help maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab) and follow infrastructure-as-code practices (AWS CDK). 
 
• Contribute to the documentation of software features and functionality. 
 
• Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies related to cloud, serverless, and data integration development. 

 Qualifications

 Required Qualifications 

• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 
• Strong understanding of programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++. 
 
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and building or consuming REST APIs. 
 
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 
• Strong communication and teamwork abilities. 
 
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 

• Exposure to AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, or infrastructure-as-code (CDK/CloudFormation). 
 
• Experience with front-end frameworks such as React. 
 
• Knowledge of relational database systems and SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL). 
 
• Familiarity with data integration or low-code/iPaaS platforms such as Boomi. 
 
• Experience with version control and CI/CD workflows (Git/GitLab). 
 
• Previous internship or project experience in software development. 
 
 Important Dates:  

 Start Date: May 17, 2027

 End Date: Aug 6, 2027

 Note: This is a hybrid role, you must be able to travel to the office.

 The US hourly rate for this position is $25.
fit_why: Full-stack TS/Node/React/PostgreSQL plus Python APIs, matching core stack

jd:
We’re currently looking to add a group of Software Engineering Interns to this nerd club of ours. If you’re someone who has basic programming skills, and is currently going through a formal computer science program, or have recently completed one, we might be a good match! Here at Lean TECHniques, we work with Fortune 500 companies to help take technology from a cost center, to a competitive advantage.

 

Here’s what you can expect in an internship with LT:

You’ll join forces with 3-5 other team members to deliver high-quality, low-maintenance software solutions that help organizations cement their place in the digital economy.

You’ll help LT improve some of our internal systems, and work on code that we use day to day.

You’ll learn test-driven development practices to help write high-quality code.

You’ll continue to refine your craft and grow your skills through ongoing training, personal development and other learning opportunities that help you reach your goals.

 

What Skills Do You Bring to the Table?

Know how to program in one or more languages. We believe we can teach you the specifics that are needed, but you’ll need to know how to approach problems programmatically.

Able to work within a team. Our teams are successful because we know how to get along and treat each other as professionals.

A positive attitude. We work on hard problems and engineering can be frustrating at times, so bringing a positive attitude can help see you through the rough times.
fit_why: Generic intern role; basic programming, no specific stack; team fit is fine

jd:
We are looking for a motivated Technology Intern to help build the systems that run our business. Our Technology team is in building mode. We’re replacing off-the-shelf software with an in-house solution, a platform built around how Pathlabs works, and putting AI to work across the company. This role is perfect for someone who wants to build real tools with AI that teams use every day. You’ll use AI coding tools like Claude Code to turn business requirements into working features, and you’ll be responsible for making sure what gets built is accurate, secure and useful. You’ll work directly with our Technology, Media Services, Support and Data teams.

* This internship will be paid and can be used towards college credits at The University of Montana.  
 Key Responsibilities 
 
• Pair with members of the Technology team to plan, build, test and launch new work 
• Build new features for our internal operating system, from product requirement documents and conversations with stakeholders and subject-matter experts 
• Use AI coding tools to build and update features across our platforms 
• Build and improve AI agents and skills that automate work for teams across the company 
• Build and maintain internal apps on low-code platforms to support daily workflows 
• Build custom apps and tools outside of our core operating system when teams need something new 
• Review, test and check AI-generated work before it reaches users 
• Make sure what you build handles data accurately and securely 
• Investigate and fix bugs reported by the teams who use our tools 
• Gather feedback from users and turn it into improvements 
• Document what you build so others can use and maintain it What We're Looking For 
 Essential Skills 
 
• Ability to break a business problem into clear, step-by-step requirements 
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, especially when checking AI-generated work 
• Comfortable learning new tools and technical systems quickly 
• Clear communication skills for working with technical and non-technical teammates Educational Background 
 
• Currently studying or recently graduated in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems or a related field 
• Coding experience (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or SQL) and familiarity with AI tools (Claude, LLM APIs, AI agents) are helpful but not required The Right Mindset 
 
• Curiosity about how systems work and why they break 
• Ownership of quality: you test your work before calling it done 
• Healthy skepticism of AI output and a habit of verifying it 
• Interest in solving real problems for the people using your tools 
• Comfort asking questions and taking feedback from teammates 
• Interest in how the business runs so you can build tools that fit it What You'll Gain 
 This internship offers hands-on engineering experience, including: 
 
• Building and launching features used daily by teams across the company 
• Real experience building with AI coding tools, agents and automation 
• Working alongside the Technology team and learning how they plan, build and ship 
• Exposure to the full build process, from requirements to testing to launch 
• Seeing how a business runs from the inside and how technology supports each team 
• Experience working with technical and non-technical stakeholders 
• A portfolio of real projects you can point to in future roles
fit_why: Full-stack and AI-agent building; low-code and business-facing scope

jd:
Overview

 We are seeking a full-time Software Engineer Intern  at Garmin's Chanhassen, MN location. In this role on the Aviation Cloud Data Content team, you will be responsible for learning and training to develop software for aeronautical and weather data, developing features for products across Garmin's mobile, web, and avionics platforms in a team-oriented environment under supervision. 

 Essential Functions 

• Learn to develop software in C, C++, Java, Assembly language, or other selected languages for Garmin communication and navigation products in accordance with Garmin’s software development methodology with guidance 
 
• Learn to test software using debuggers, emulators, simulators, and logic analyzers 
 
• Learn to perform software releases and software quality assurance activities 
 
• Learn to perform maintenance activities for products already in production in addition to new product software design 
 
• Associates are expected to integrate, use, and provide feedback on products in development when possible as part of their normal job responsibilities 

 Basic Qualifications 

• Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a field relevant to perform the essential functions of this job description 
 
• Excellent academics (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.0 as a general rule) 
 
• Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills 
 
• Must possess relevant experience and/or training in a high-level language such as C, C++, C# or Java relevant to Garmin’s business needs 
 
• Must possess relevant experience and/or training in data structures or object-oriented design methodology relevant to Garmin’s business needs 
 
 Desired Qualifications 

• Pursuing a master's degree in Geomatics, Aerospace or Software engineering 
 
• Outstanding academics (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.5) 
 
• Previous experience working in a team environment 
 
• Experience with C++, Java, Python, or other selected languages 
 
• Knowledge of Linux environments 
 
• Knowledge of CI/CD such as Jenkins 

 Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran's status, age or disability. 

 This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here: Garmin Intern Benefits
fit_why: Core ask is C/C++/Java embedded avionics software; his web stack doesn't fit

InfiniteQuant is a global quantitative trading and technology company. 
 As a privately owned proprietary trading firm, we research, develop, and deploy high-frequency quantitative trading strategies across global financial markets.
 Our entire technology stack, from market data infrastructure and research platforms to simulation engines, execution systems, and trading strategies, is built in-house.
 Our high-frequency trading strategies generate hundreds of millions of order messages daily across thousands of symbols on major electronic exchanges. We maintain a multi-year archive of historical tick-by-tick market data, powering quantitative research, simulation, and strategy development.

Website: www.infquant.com

jd:
We are looking for software engineer intern to join our internal platform team. You'll work across our full stack, GraphQL API (NestJS), React frontend (Next.js), and PostgreSQL database, building tools that advisors use to make real investment decisions. Scope scales with experience: early-career developers ship well-scoped features with mentorship, while senior developers drive architecture decisions and mentor others.
 Responsibilities
 
• Design, build, and ship features end-to-end across our internal platform. 
• Build and maintain integrations with financial data providers, including Black Diamond, Capital IQ, FMP, Box, and Redtail, including authentication, error handling, and data parsing. 
• Develop analytics and decision tools, including portfolio metrics, earnings tracking, and risk analysis used by advisors for real investment decisions. 
• Build AI-powered features, including document search, chat over internal knowledge, and workflow automation. 
• Participate in code review, testing, and the ongoing architectural restructure of the platform.

• Experience building and shipping real software in TypeScript or JavaScript, whether professional, academic, or personal projects. 
• Full-stack reasoning: understanding how a UI change relates to an API, and how an API relates to its data. 
• Clear, readable code and constructive participation in code review. 
• Clear communication with non-engineers; our users are financial advisors. 
• Curiosity about the financial domain, no finance background required. 
• Comfort using LLM coding assistance such as Claude Code or OpenAI models. Nice to Have
 
• Experience with Next.js, React, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, Nx, or Bun. 
• Third-party API integration experience. 
• Fintech exposure. 
• Python experience. 
• Experience building LLM-powered features.

• Competitive hourly pay. 
• Flexible scheduling around class commitments. 
• Potential path to future opportunities with the firm. 
• Direct mentorship from experienced engineers, with scope that grows as you do. 
• Hands-on ownership of real features used by advisors for real investment decisions. 
• Exposure to modern tooling, including AI-powered development workflows and LLM coding assistants. 
• Small, collaborative engineering team with direct input into architecture and product direction.
fit_why: Full-stack TS/React/Postgres plus integrations and LLM features match core stack
